description: n512 PAF kernel (qr_panel_apply_fused, 51% of the dominant shape, the highest-remote-value kernel) has 58% Memory SOL dominated by SMEM BANK CONFLICTS, not DRAM (ncu: 1.4-way load / 1.5-way store conflicts, 28% excessive wavefronts, DRAM <13%). Attack the conflicts with SMEM layout/padding: pad the leading dimension of the V/C/W/reflector SMEM tiles to avoid 32-bank aliasing (e.g. +1 or +skew padding so consecutive rows/threads hit distinct banks), and reorder accesses for conflict-free swizzled load/store. Pure SMEM-layout change -> byte-identical math, gate-safe, remote-portable. Profile the PAF kernel's shared-load/store conflict counters before/after. This targets the actual mechanism behind the 58% memory term that cp.async could not touch.
